basics.name: Kyle M. Anderson
basics.summary: Technical manager and lead developer with experience delivering and supporting software integrations, coordinating development projects, and translating business requirements into technical solutions. Work spans platform modernization, cloud migration, performance optimization, implementation support, and client communication.

work.name: DSTax Technologies
work.summary: Technical lead, lead developer, and project manager for a tax-integration platform, with responsibilities across development, implementation, troubleshooting, and client support.
highlights: Managed internal development projects and client-coordinated work, communicating integration updates, reporting status, and responding to questions and requests.
Supported end-to-end integration implementations, including requirements gathering, setup, troubleshooting, and go-live support.
Led the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of the tax-integration platform, broadening tax-provider and financial-platform support and improving UI/UX.
Developed integrations between financial platforms and tax providers, supporting platforms including Acumatica, Chargebee, Sage Intacct, WooCommerce, and Magento/Adobe Commerce.
Optimized asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput.
Migrated production workloads from DigitalOcean to AWS.
Created and maintained client guides and knowledge-base articles.

work.name: Colectivo Coffee Roasters
highlights: Partnered with the IT department to install and troubleshoot new point-of-sale nodes.
Fulfilled orders for more than 1000 restaurant and store clients and assisted with training new hires.

work.name: Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global)
highlights: Analyzed asset and facilities databases, identifying more than $10 million in previously unidentified asset value that informed the sale of unused assets before Komatsu's acquisition of Joy Global.
Evaluated, selected, and implemented a global mapping platform that provided facility information to employees and customers.
Initiated web automations that reduced manual database-maintenance work.
Managed SharePoint sites and data and designed data-input forms to improve accessibility, reduce errors, and promote cross-department information sharing.

education.area: Industrial Engineering and Supply Chain/Operations Management

coverLetter:
Dear Hiring Team,
I am applying for the Manager, Software Engineering role at Molson Coors. My background combines hands-on software development, technical leadership, integration implementation, and client support. As a Manager at DSTax Technologies, I serve as a technical lead and lead developer for a tax-integration platform, connecting business requirements with development work and helping clients through implementation and ongoing support.

At DSTax, I led the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of the platform, broadening support for tax providers and financial platforms while improving the user experience. My work also included optimizing asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput and migrating production workloads from DigitalOcean to AWS. Alongside development, I managed internal projects and client-coordinated work, reported status, and supported requirements gathering, setup, troubleshooting, and go-live activities. That combination is relevant to the role’s emphasis on technical delivery, optimization, and stakeholder support. A second example comes from Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global), where I evaluated, selected, and implemented a global mapping platform that made facility information available to employees and customers. I also introduced web automations to reduce manual database maintenance and designed SharePoint data-input forms to improve accessibility and reduce errors. This work connected platform decisions and practical development with business information needs and cross-department collaboration.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to Molson Coors’ Commercial Technology solutions. The role’s combination of hands-on engineering, business partnership, and continuous improvement connects closely with the work described above and offers a meaningful setting for applying that experience. Thank you for considering my application. I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss how my technical leadership and delivery experience could support your engineering teams.
Sincerely,
Kyle M. Anderson
reviewNotes: Emphasized technical leadership, platform modernization, cloud migration, implementation support, and stakeholder communication. The master does not establish direct supervisory or performance-management responsibility, five years developing sales and marketing SaaS applications, agile team leadership, formal testing ownership, engineering mentorship, outsourced development oversight, international team leadership, or Sr. Director+ communication.
